limitations: Idaho has no firms advertising in the FindLaw Patents directory (patents page lists cities only, no firm cards), so the jurisdiction was completed through the FindLaw Trademarks and Intellectual Property & Copyright directories instead. Idaho Commerce/tech-transfer boutiques outside FindLaw are not covered by this source.
